rules.name: Immediate Order Locking on Failure
rules.statement: The system must immediately release all stock locks associated with an Order Request upon detection of a system outage or data corruption event.
rules.condition: when a system failure or data corruption is detected during order preparation or allocation
exceptions: manual override by a senior operations manager for high-value orders
rules.if_violated: The business risks overselling inventory, causing order fulfillment failures, and incurring regulatory penalties for inaccurate stock reporting.
rules.rationale: Preventing error propagation ensures that corrupted data does not lead to double-booking of perishable goods during critical outages.

parameters.name: outage_detection_threshold
parameters.description: the latency or error rate trigger that defines a system failure

rules.name: Strict Identity-Contact Consistency
rules.statement: A Customer Profile must not be activated if the provided contact details do not exactly match the verified identity document.
rules.condition: during the Customer Profile activation process
rules.if_violated: The business faces regulatory non-compliance risks and potential fraud due to unverified user identities.
rules.rationale: Ensuring data integrity and regulatory adherence by preventing activation of profiles with inconsistent identity information.

parameters.name: verification_tolerance_level
parameters.description: the allowable character difference for name/address matching (proposed)

rules.name: Immutable Audit Trail for Settlements
rules.statement: Every Financial Transaction Record and Settlement event must generate an immutable audit trail that cannot be altered or deleted.
rules.condition: for every financial transaction and settlement event
rules.if_violated: The business loses the ability to prove compliance during audits, risking severe legal penalties and loss of trust.
rules.rationale: Maintaining an unchangeable record of financial movements is essential for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

parameters.name: retention_period
parameters.description: the minimum legal requirement duration for the operating zone (proposed)

rules.name: Perishable Priority Allocation
rules.statement: Perishable items must be prioritized for allocation to Order Requests based on their proximity to the expiration date.
rules.condition: when allocating stock to multiple concurrent Order Requests
exceptions: manual override by store manager for high-margin non-perishable substitution
rules.if_violated: The business incurs increased waste costs and potential food safety violations due to expired goods being sold.
rules.rationale: Minimizing waste and ensuring food safety by selling items closest to expiration first.

parameters.name: expiration_priority_weight
parameters.description: the factor determining priority based on days remaining (proposed)

rules.name: Immediate Dispute Escalation
rules.statement: Unresolved financial disputes must be escalated to a senior support tier within a maximum allowed duration.
rules.condition: when a dispute is flagged during the settlement cycle
exceptions: complex fraud cases requiring external audit
rules.if_violated: revenue distribution is blocked and regulatory penalties may be applied
rules.rationale: delayed resolution erodes partner trust and triggers regulatory scrutiny

parameters.name: maximum allowed duration
parameters.description: time limit for initial dispute triage

rules.name: Fraud-Induced Settlement Halt
rules.statement: Settlement processing must not proceed for any transaction flagged with high-risk indicators until manual verification is complete.
rules.condition: when a transaction is identified as high-risk
rules.if_violated: revenue leakage occurs and regulatory compliance is breached
rules.rationale: prevents financial loss and ensures regulatory adherence during high-volume cycles

parameters.name: high-risk threshold
parameters.description: criteria defining a transaction as high-risk

rules.name: Dispute-Linked Settlement Hold
rules.statement: Final settlement status must not transition to 'Completed' until the associated dispute ticket is resolved to a final state.
rules.condition: when a Financial Transaction Record has an active dispute
exceptions: disputes resolved via automated refund reversal
rules.if_violated: incorrect funds are distributed leading to reconciliation errors
rules.rationale: ensures financial integrity by preventing premature payouts on contested transactions

parameters.name: final resolution state
parameters.description: status indicating dispute is fully closed

rules.name: Immutable Dispute Audit Trail
rules.statement: Every dispute event and its resolution action must be recorded in an immutable audit trail.
rules.condition: when a dispute is created, modified, or resolved
rules.if_violated: inability to prove compliance during regulatory audits
rules.rationale: provides verifiable evidence of fair dispute handling for regulatory bodies

parameters.name: retention period
parameters.description: duration for keeping immutable audit logs

rules.name: Immutable Anomaly Logging
rules.statement: The system must append every operational anomaly to a cryptographically secured, immutable audit log that cannot be altered or deleted.
rules.condition: when an operational anomaly occurs during order preparation, allocation, or fulfillment
rules.if_violated: The business faces regulatory fines, legal liability, and loss of trust due to inability to prove compliance
rules.rationale: Regulatory authorities require a tamper-proof record to verify adherence to labor and food safety laws during investigations

parameters.name: retention_period
parameters.description: duration the immutable log must be preserved

rules.name: Anomaly Status Transition Validation
rules.statement: A status transition for an anomaly record is valid only if the new status logically follows the previous status in the defined lifecycle.
rules.condition: when an anomaly record changes state from one lifecycle stage to another
exceptions: manual override by a designated Compliance Officer with dual authorization
rules.if_violated: The audit trail becomes unreliable, leading to potential rejection of compliance evidence by regulators
rules.rationale: Logical consistency in state changes ensures the integrity of the root cause analysis timeline

rules.name: Anomaly Resolution Evidence Linking
rules.statement: An anomaly record may only be marked as 'Resolved' if it is linked to verifiable evidence proving the issue was addressed.
rules.condition: when an operator attempts to change an anomaly status to 'Resolved'
rules.if_violated: False closure of anomalies hides recurring risks and violates food safety or labor law mandates
rules.rationale: Proof of resolution is essential for accurate root cause analysis and regulatory compliance

parameters.name: evidence_types
parameters.description: list of acceptable evidence formats (e.g., photo, signature, timestamped log)

rules.name: Regulatory License Anomaly Escalation
rules.statement: The system must automatically escalate an anomaly related to a Store Partner's license expiration to a Compliance Officer if the expiration date is within 30 days.
rules.condition: when an anomaly is detected regarding a Store Partner's license validity
rules.if_violated: The business risks accepting orders from unlicensed partners, leading to severe legal penalties
rules.rationale: Proactive management of license anomalies prevents illegal operations and ensures continuous regulatory compliance

parameters.name: escalation_threshold_days
parameters.description: number of days before expiration triggering escalation

rules.name: Service Area Pre-Activation Validation
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not be used to validate new Order Requests unless it is in an active state.
rules.condition: when an Order Request is submitted for a specific geographic zone
exceptions: Emergency override protocols defined in FR-050
rules.if_violated: The order request is rejected and the customer is notified of service unavailability in that zone
rules.rationale: Ensures orders are only processed in zones where operational readiness and logistics support are confirmed

parameters.name: active_state_threshold
parameters.description: The required status for a Service Area to accept orders

rules.name: Regulatory Zone Boundary Constraint
rules.statement: A Service Area Definition may only be created if its geographic boundaries do not overlap with any zone restricted by the Regulatory Authority.
rules.condition: during the creation of a new Service Area Definition
rules.if_violated: The creation request is automatically rejected and an audit trail is generated for regulatory review
rules.rationale: Prevents illegal operations in restricted areas and ensures adherence to local laws

parameters.name: restricted_zone_list
parameters.description: Current list of geographically restricted zones

rules.name: Dynamic Surge Pricing Eligibility
rules.statement: Surge pricing may only be applied when the ratio of active orders to available delivery agents exceeds the configured capacity threshold AND the predicted wait time does not exceed the maximum acceptable delay defined in the Service Area Definition.
rules.condition: when calculating delivery fees during periods of high demand
rules.if_violated: The surge pricing calculation is bypassed, and standard rates are applied to maintain customer trust
rules.rationale: Balances revenue optimization with the core value proposition of ultra-fast delivery

parameters.name: capacity_threshold_ratio
parameters.description: The minimum order-to-agent ratio required to trigger surge pricing

parameters.name: max_acceptable_delay
parameters.description: The maximum wait time allowed before surge pricing is prohibited

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Synchronization
rules.statement: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot must be updated to mark items as unavailable if the logistics link status indicates a network disruption or route constraint.
rules.condition: when external network status indicates a route constraint or latency threshold is exceeded
exceptions: Manual override by Store Partner for critical items
rules.if_violated: Customers may receive orders that cannot be fulfilled, leading to cancellations and reputational damage
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling by ensuring inventory data reflects actual logistical capability

parameters.name: network_disruption_threshold
parameters.description: The latency level considered a network disruption
